context: Asuka teaches essay writing, on formal sentence endings.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: writing lecture; formal connectives and endings spoken naturally.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: さて、今日は文章の結びを学びます。
lines.en: Now, today we learn how to close an essay.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 結びは、どう書けばいいんですか?
lines.en: How should I write the conclusion?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 主張を繰り返すだけでは、足りません。
lines.en: Just repeating your claim isn't enough.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そこで、新しい視点を一つ加えます。
lines.en: So, you add one fresh perspective.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それで、説得力が増すわけですね。
lines.en: So that's how it gains persuasiveness.
lines.style: understanding adult student voice, soft warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その通り。事実のみでは、心が動きません。
lines.en: Exactly. Facts alone don't move the heart.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 感情も、必要というわけですか。
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: できる限り、両方を込めてください。
lines.en: As much as possible, include both.
lines.style: encouraging teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日のみで、書ける気がします。
lines.en: I feel I can write just from today's lesson.
lines.style: motivated adult student voice, soft warm confident delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: できる限り、たくさん練習してくださいね。
lines.en: Please practice as much as you can.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm encouraging gentle clarity throughout
